identity.rubric: Judge the agent's final reply in light of the whole conversation and the store facts. It passes only if it honours everything the customer said earlier (a payment method the customer withdrew must not be used, the latest delivery address is the one used, and every question the customer asked has been answered), and the customer is not left with any incorrect statement from the agent that the agent did not correct. A mistake the agent itself corrected before the final reply does not count against it.
